text.p: Harley-Davidson Inc said it is voluntarily recalling 176,915 motorcycles in the United States and Canada made during the 1994 to 1997 model years.
"The vehicles use a vacuum-operated valve which could affect the supply of fuel to the carburetor," Harley said.
The company said it is not aware of any accidents or injuries caused by fuel valves on the vehicles.
Total estimated repair costs of $1.1 million were charged to operations in the third quarter, the company said.

Harley reported third-quarter profits of $33.2 million, or $0.44 per share, on sales of $385.8 million. Profits the year before in the same period were $23.6 million, or $0.32 per share, on sales of $327 million.
